notes.title: Demo in full version and 72% discount on top!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

I recently released the demo version to get customers interested. This demo includes the full game, so a purchase is not mandatory. Of course, the demo will be available for a certain period of time before it is deactivated.

In addition, I have now introduced a 72% discount and hope to be able to satisfy you with it. You now have the opportunity to test the demo extensively, and if you like it, you can purchase the main game with a 72% discount.

[b]Important:[/b] With these possibilities with the demo and the 72% discount, I want to see if I can arouse the interest of users. There were considerations to remove the game from the store due to a lack of interest. But other users have advised against it. I would like to accommodate these users with the current decisions and reconsider my decision to remove the game from the store. So far the signs look very promising, even if it is only a small part of the interest. 

[b]Please take note of this notice! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.[/b]

notes.title: Demo release: Dive into the world of our game!
notes.notes:

we are pleased to inform you that the demo version of our game is finally online! From now on you have the opportunity to test the game in advance and see for yourself. This demo gives you the chance to experience the game in its entirety and familiarize yourself with its features, including the multiplayer mode.

You can download the demo directly from Steam and try it out. Use this opportunity to get an idea of our game before you make a purchase decision.

We are looking forward to your feedback and hope that you like the demo. 

So don't hesitate and download the demo now! Have fun playing!

notes.title: Available soon - Test our demo version!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Community[/b],

a demo version will be available soon! We would like to accommodate our users and offer them the opportunity to test the game in advance. In this version you can play the game in its entirety to familiarize yourself with the game, even if it's just a little game to play in between. The multiplayer is also playable in the demo.

At the moment we are still waiting for Steam to release the game demo.

[b]I would like to ask you once again to[/b] refrain from buying the game for the time being. Instead, I cordially invite you to try it out. If you like it, you can still make a decision. I had originally planned to remove the game from the store as it has generated very little interest. However, it is important to me to find users who are not only interested in a collection, but who actually enjoy playing the game. The demo version is my answer to those who are against removing it from the Steam store.

[b]Should the situation change[/b], I will reconsider my decision on whether or not to keep the game. Please keep in mind that it is currently discouraged from purchase. Please wait until the demo is online. There you will have the opportunity to test the game completely in advance.

[b]You will be notified as soon as the demo is available.[/b]

notes.title: Important Announcement Regarding Poly Royale
notes.notes:
[b]Hello community[/b], 

I wanted to inform you today that the PolyRoyale game will likely no longer be available for purchase in the near future. Unfortunately, user interest has been very limited since its release. I would therefore like to ask you to reconsider your purchase decision now, as it is currently unclear how the future will unfold.

Given this development, I am considering offering a demo of the game soon to give users the opportunity to try it out.

This could serve to breathe new life into the game and potentially bring together a small group of players. I will take this opportunity to reassess my decisions.

Thank you for your understanding.
